newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes 14 cents higher at 14.29 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes 14 cents higher at 14.29 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose 14 cents to 14.29 ringgit ($5.76) a kg, following an overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The market was helped by the overnight rise on London," said a trader. "There were no other factors, considering today's Good Friday."
There were 183 tonnes bid initially, against 106 offered. Final turnover was 126 tonnes, compared to 59 on Thursday, and was absorbed by European, Japanese and Malaysian interests.
The price was a premium of $45 over London, against $40 on Wednesday. -- K. Baranee Krishnaan (603-2307509) ($1=2.4820)
